notes.title: Dev Log #10 - Desert Biome First Look
notes.content:
[h2]The Desert Hills[/h2]
The 2nd promised Biome is here. ... Only First Tile actually I call it (Desert - Forward) it have 1 place to large building and 2 small places for small buildings.

[*] Lets start this dev log
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/15f29be8eee2f09f087f599f79dd454cdd9674bd.png[/img]

[*] So forest biome have river so its hard to cross the tile, so desert have Elevated Hills, its like the tile is on 2 levels
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/3acdb6fcb8f8cfe70e1dc6626669368056fdd571.png[/img]

[*] Cards and  chests will be hidden on top levels, so if you placed a 6 star tile you need access both top and bottom to see all the loot
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/f1a7133b82492709f90530be17c831c4997009b3.png[/img]

[*] If you are at top you can inspect bottom loot if its not hiding inside a building, and need certain tiles to access the elevated hills
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/7c1e3e55f2daaeca4e3443591e8113d1e9b39633.png[/img]

[*] too much time is spent to make sure no player soft lock him self, so explore freely you wont get stuck
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/12328a5901a11bf8581fc0be9b8d887fa116fcd9.png[/img]

[*] Because you read the whole dev log, here is some Map view perspective 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/bdfa1ce66524f2c51b0cd7c5e49c8b233f0e21fe.png[/img]

Join & share you ideas here: [url=https://discord.gg/9D8g8Hj6NE]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Dev Log #6 - Temple Design
notes.content:
[h2]Temple Design[/h2]
Placing a white wall in the middle of the forest is good for minimalist style, but not that classy.

[*]More details needed to be added without moving far from game design
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/928eaf6fcc60b890c3af7eb21e2799274251f35b.png[/img]

[*]So, yes. "Torri" is the solution here
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/8288ffab2b9e0b192e914a82a26a5bbe06c18de8.png[/img]

[*]With a twist, some temples will be submerged
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/2435d3ea209c8255d00cf56d555117d152ebc16a.png[/img]

[*]This means you cant use it without having a "Swim" action card
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/3c410076e2b9e6bb556d96484fcba73e72718177.png[/img]

[*]Temples come in 2 sizes, large which is house sized and small which is yard sized. large temple have 2 cards place holder, and small temples have 1 card place holder. Temple cards need a specific size to work
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/d8b62a3ac49c9a6578b81ad7403b37f31c273d9e.png[/img]

Join & share you ideas here: [url=https://discord.gg/9D8g8Hj6NE]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Dev Log #5 - Temple Cards
notes.content:
[h2]Temple cards[/h2]
This is the dev log where you know what buildings will you find in forest biome

[*]Temple cards can only be used inside temples, at first you will find temple spawn with cards in them
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/5061fd7d2f0d8f4b7d5ed816b168dacb2fd82ce9.png[/img]

[*]First Temple Card is "Dual Offer", lets you select one of 2 cards that have same rarity as the temple cards but card mods are hidden.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/4e88bafc2938aa8688a7c7f00628cd7ca7818df8.png[/img]

[*]2nd Temple Card is "Dual Sacrifice", lets you Sacrifice 2 cards for a random card its rarity depends on Sacrificed cards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/ed865ba6f345d5e4deec54035dea00ddc0f78338.png[/img]

[*]3rd Temple Card is "Dual Fusion", lets you merge 2 cards into 1 card
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/353f79481ce3c4c1daa33c70deea281a253454f9.png[/img]

[*]Drag and drop mechanic is the worst, I replaced it so you click on the card then you click on place holder, its quicker and easier with a controller

Join & share you ideas here: [url=https://discord.gg/9D8g8Hj6NE]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Dev Log #3 - Forest River Turn Tile
notes.content:
[h2]New Forest Tile[/h2]
that makes 2 forest tiles so far.


[*] Forest tiles are being tested and guess what I found new bugs that only appears because of curved surfaces of the forest, so it had to be fixed in the demo and also in the release, that's why you saw many updates to the demo last couple of weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/778886f51981aaf1da81fab08f1a4ee2b6c08a0b.jpg[/img]

[*] lets jump to the new tile first, I will share screenshots from "play mode" and let you guess what it looks like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/18ee3f1ee79948c69e4e3496102f0cc94376e4da.png[/img]

[*] the very good news is, the forest tiles really captured the feeling the game needed, here you see river is going in curved path, this means less time will be spent on those tiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/6bf2e72f0fa9d774822310d0a7d1933fbfd39728.jpg[/img]

[*] this tile have 2 bridges, so there is only 12.5% for tile to have complete bridges to cross both sides with a car. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/fcad41003299c515e942f536999e50c0b23c8d88.jpg[/img]

[*] now its possible to see more than one river at the same time, this makes it that you can easily make your way by looking into map quickly

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/6a21ad79fb11dfe22c9f03ec600e6a22f0437f82.jpg[/img]

[*] Tall Trees will make it hard to tell which is north.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/2460926ab17934fde459521a712bcdd80f0e0634.jpg[/img]

[*] Hidden paths will be found between trees, those paths will be wide enough for you to fight nightmares in them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/b116c1ec004017c8805760283c81eb5a178b2ed6.png[/img]

[*] too many screenshots were shared already, can you guess what the tile look like yet ?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/c3564f1e4a6783e6c81c773a1033edfafaefb772.jpg[/img]

[*] Hiding from enemies is too easy in the forest just find a big tree, also stealth kills are more fun there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/2460926ab17934fde459521a712bcdd80f0e0634.jpg[/img]

[*] You have to note that in the forest you will find less cards than the city also hard to find.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/0ecfabb034c25151440ca09cbb856710f68d0aae.jpg[/img]

[*] thats what the tile look like from build mode, it have both a curved road and a curved river intersecting

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/9c70eab914f72a3ece799e330807f347fd8df1ef.png[/img]

[*] they were plans to make another 2 tiles (Forest - River End) & (Forest - No River) adding them may cost a delay in release date later, so those will be delayed for an update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/2df4bb8862be67a4012e1a6ac17e7eb540929b30.png[/img]

[*] Next steps: Adding building for forest tiles and Adding swimming. I dont know which comes first, but once both of those are done expect a rare devlog

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/172aaca930b62ebe8dd3d8bebc6e63073b4879e7.png[/img]

[h2]ok that's it for today. See you next dev log
Join & share you ideas here: [url=https://discord.gg/9D8g8Hj6NE]Discord[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Dev Log #2 - The bridge
notes.content:
[h2]BEHOLD THE BRIDGE[/h2]
another dev log so soon YAY.

[h1]The Bridge[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/f953f40130002a19784987a4f84d642b4c9cca06.png[/img]

[*] This is what it looks like when you stand on it

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/19e70b1d62156786432de48ac4536c2a26253efc.png[/img]

[*] This is what it looks like from far

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/643705c5fae471ce36ac2674ecbbfb1712235792.png[/img]

[*] another screenshot of the bridge

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/a60db2f2561da1be2133a1752f11e8a8254c12a3.png[/img]

[*] Last screenshot of the bridge I promise

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/c83dd85185825575694c9013d3549e8debc461c4.png[/img]

[*] almost forgot this one tho. the bridge have 25% chance to spawn without being damaged and 50% chance for it to spawn with one side of the bridge damaged and 25% chance not to spawn at all. so you cant rely on the forest to be your main path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/b94ec1483c81ece631aa88954eb0070ca10497a2.png[/img]

[*] right now any building can spawn in the forest but that will not be the case in the future, each biome should have its unique buildings (or does it ?). its like a glitch seeing a parking lot in the middle of the forest

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/d0646a736f8886c61be1c85d5ab110892100616d.png[/img]

[*] no thing fancy here just intersection of river and city biome

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/7f9fc9498be5406aae4ae8f0e7814f0ad4125a6e.png[/img]

[*] I changed roads in the forest to be dirt

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/f92c011cbebaa4615d556f957f157c271a6cf28a.png[/img]

[*] now lets jump to map view !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/407ef7a2b4ec6806438c9d36e04e24efc51e5ae1.png[/img]

[*] placing 2 rivers next to each other gives 1 star (river connect)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/da13085c9592475446116f188e53bebfab2e506c.png[/img]

[*] placing 2 forest tiles next to each other gives 1 star (same biome)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/988d897a91057c2db8c2ec42b2633a556d47a117.png[/img]

[*] Getting 6 stars on forest tiles will be easy as long as its next to forest biome its even easier than the city

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/8674236872d6445ade312993015d9a1795d934fc.png[/img]

[*] Tile (Forest with a River going in straight line) is now complete, next will be (Forest with a river going in a curve). still mapping the tile out.

[h2]ok that's it for today. See you next dev log

notes.title: Getting the demo ready for next fest
notes.content:
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
    [*](Furnace Chimney) Spinning Flame Attack Buffed by 300%, old: 3 Dmg/Sec - New: 15 Dmg/Sec
    [*]If (Furnace Chimney) knocked out of map it will respawn in same tile and get damaged for 10% of its max health
    [*]Added button sound for when player uses shortcuts to use a card
    [*]Added button sound for card sub-buttons
    [*]If an enemy hit a car with a velocity then both will take damage and vice versa
    [*]Game will now auto pause if game lost focus (of course will make an option to turn this off, but that's future me task)
    [*]Player will now be seen by enemy if he attacked an enemy while having high stealth modifier
    [*]Added animation for live map anchor
    [*]Player will now start game sitting down rather than spawn from no where
    [*]Player will now know where he will spawn before going to play mode
    [*]Increased map view camera speed, and decreased drag to prevent misplacement of tiles
[/list]
[h3]Optimization[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Improved all pathfinding calculations for enemies
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed weapon modifier (+Energy next Turn) not stack energy if weapon used more than once
    [*]Fixed weapon modifier (+Energy next Turn) not stacking with modifer (+Energy if killed an enemy)
    [*]Fixed (Stone Bender) not rotating correctly when using spin attack and cant reach player
    [*]Fixed softlock if player knocked (Furnace Chimney) out of map
    [*]Fixed enemies not detecting player if the player attacked an enemy with a car
[/list]
